title: 第十七章 再获宝鱼飞速成长第十八章 痛打落水狗
content_zh:
统御六须鲶鱼真是物超所值，距离上次发现牛角鲳还不到五天，今天就又带来惊喜。
要是平均每五天就能抓到一头宝鱼，整个杨氏武馆的人怕是都没有如此奢侈的吧？
想到这，梁渠脚步都加快许多，半个时辰就赶回义兴市。
平阳镇边上也是泽野，其实可以直接入水，但为了不引人瞩目，他还是选择回埠头。
到了埠头，通过精神链接中的方位感应，梁渠出船赶到附近，船桨拍打水面，收到呼唤的猪婆龙浮出水面接应。
江淮泽野并没有看上去那么风平浪静，深处大妖不提，浅水区有些猪婆龙物种不同，体长能到四五米，掀翻小舢板不在话下，有不能动护卫能安全些。
梁渠拿上抄网潜入水中，吃完牛角鲳后他就卖鱼学武去了，融合度提升后还没下过水，此刻只感觉一阵轻松自在。
【鼎主：梁渠】
【炼化泽灵：水猴子（白）（融合度：8.3%）】
【水泽精华：无】
【河流眷顾度：无】
【统御水兽：太华鳄，六须鲶鱼】
【评价：水猴泽灵源自于伟大的淮涡之主，可激发不足，性微命弱的小人物】
融合度已经来到8.3，能控制的水流达到了五十斤，控制力有些许提升，证明梁渠当初的想法是对的。
泽灵融合度提升，不仅水流强度变大，还能提升掌控力，变成水刀，控制血液指日可待，一片欣欣向荣。
并且梁渠再看到最底下的评价，也有了些思考。
获得泽鼎后，他时常观摩鼎上的纹路，没猜错的话，所谓的淮涡之主应该就是大名鼎鼎的无支祁。
无支祁本体就是一只巨猿，青躯白首、金目雪牙，和泽鼎上最醒目的纹路相符。
传说中大禹联合应龙都无法杀死它，只能囚禁于水底。
应龙是谁？

那是古代神话传说中的创世神、造物神，真龙与龙族始祖，传说鱼虾喝一口应龙的尿就能成为真龙！
对比下来可见一斑。
至于其他的纹路应是其他水神，人首蛇身的就疑似共工。
另一面黑帝不知道是谁，直觉告诉梁渠他很牛逼，尤其是持枪神将的枪望着很像三尖两刃啊，不会是二郎神吧，二郎神是水神吗？
如此一来，泽鼎绝对是了不得的神器。
据说江淮泽野最深处蛰伏着蛟龙，一眠一甲子，苏醒后便会兴风作浪，但在无支祁面前就是一根辣条。
只可惜自己只是水猴子，距离淮涡之主差了十万八千里。
前路漫漫，尚需努力！
在猪婆龙的护送下，梁渠找到肥鲶鱼，发现所谓宝鱼其是一条浑身长满橘色虎斑的大头鱼！
正是上月隔壁埠头有人抓到过的虎头斑！
只不过眼前这条体型巨大，足有臂长，差不多有六七斤，要是卖钱，可能比先前的牛角鲳更贵！
阿肥，你可真是我的福星！
梁渠高兴地拍了拍肥鲶鱼脑袋，让两兽前往另外两个方向，与自己呈三面包抄之势围拢。
借着水猴子的能力梁渠不易被鱼类发现，他让肥鲶鱼和猪婆龙率先发起攻势。
被吓到的虎头斑转身逃窜，结果冲到梁渠身边才发现早有人埋伏，再想逃时已然来不及，巨大的惯性让它根本转不了弯。
数十斤水流挤压在虎头斑身上，禁锢其身形。
梁渠扭转身体，抄网一挥，如同打出一杆漂亮的高尔夫球，将虎头斑套入网中！
漂亮！
梁渠迅速翻转抄网杆，将虎头斑包在网中，上前连鱼带网抱在怀中，一路上游回到水面，扔进船舱。
content_en:
The six-bearded catfish is really worth the money. It has been less than five days since the horned pomfret was last found, and today brought another surprise.
If you can catch a treasure fish every five days on average, then probably no one in the Yang Family Martial Arts School has such luxury, right?
Thinking of this, Liang Qu sped up a lot and rushed back to Yixing City in half an hour.
There is also Zeye on the edge of Pingyang Town. In fact, you can enter the water directly, but in order not to attract attention, he still chose to go back to the port.
When he arrived at the port, through the direction sensing in his spiritual link, Liang Qu got out of the boat and rushed to the nearby area. The oars slapped the water, and Zhu Polong, who received the call, surfaced to respond.
Jianghuai Zeye is not as calm as it seems. Not to mention the monsters in the depths, there are some pig dragons in the shallow water of different species, which can reach four or five meters in length. It is not a problem to overturn the small sampan. It will be safer if there are no moving guards.
Liang Qu took the fishing net and dived into the water. After eating the horned pomfret, he went to sell fish to learn martial arts. He had not been in the water since his fusion level was improved. At this moment, he just felt relaxed and at ease.
[Ding Master: Liang Qu]
[Refining Zeling: Water Monkey (White) (Fusion Degree: 8.3%)]
【Water Essence: None】
[River Favor: None]
[Control water beasts: Taihua crocodile, six-bearded catfish]
[Evaluation: The Water Monkey Zeling comes from the great Lord of Huaivortex, and can inspire little people who are weak and weak]
The fusion degree has reached 8.3, and the water flow that can be controlled has reached fifty kilograms. The control power has been slightly improved, which proves that Liang Qu's original idea was right.
The increased fusion of Ze Ling not only increases the strength of the water flow, but also improves control, turning it into a water jet. Controlling the blood is just around the corner, and everything is prosperous.
And when Liang Qu saw the bottom comment again, he also had some thoughts.
After obtaining the Zeding, he often observed the patterns on the tripod. If he guessed correctly, the so-called Lord of Huaivortex should be the famous Wuzhi Qi.
Wuzhiqi's body is a giant ape, with a green body and a white head, golden eyes and snowy teeth, which matches the most eye-catching patterns on the Zeding.
According to legend, Dayu and Yinglong were unable to kill it and could only imprison it under the water.
Who is Yinglong?
That is the creator god, the god of creation, the true dragon and the ancestor of the dragon clan in ancient myths and legends. It is said that fish and shrimps can become true dragons by drinking a sip of Yinglong's urine!
This is evident by comparison.
As for the other patterns, they should be other water gods, and the one with a human head and a snake body is suspected to be Gonggong.
On the other hand, the Black Emperor didn't know who he was, but his intuition told Liang Qu that he was very awesome, especially the spear-wielding general's spear that looked like a three-pointed two-edged sword. It couldn't be Erlang Shen, was Erlang Shen the Water God?
In this way, Zeding is definitely an incredible artifact.
It is said that there is a dragon dormant in the deepest part of Jianghuai Zeye. It sleeps for a period of sixty years and will make trouble when it wakes up. But in front of Wuzhi Qi, it is like a spicy stick.
It's a pity that he is just a water monkey, and he is far away from the master of Huaiwo.
There is a long road ahead and we still need to work hard!
Under the escort of Zhu Polong, Liang Qu found the fat catfish and discovered that the so-called treasure fish was actually a big-headed fish covered with orange tiger spots!
It was exactly the tiger-headed spot that someone caught in the next port last month!
It's just that the one in front of me is huge, as long as an arm, and weighs almost six or seven pounds. If sold, it may be more expensive than the previous horned pomfret!
Ah Fei, you are really my lucky star!
Liang Qu happily patted the fat catfish on the head and asked the two beasts to go to the other two directions and surround him on three sides.
With the ability of the water monkey, Liang Qu was not easily discovered by the fish, so he let the fat catfish and the pig dragon take the lead in launching the offensive.
The frightened tiger head spot turned around and ran away. As a result, he rushed to Liang Qu and found that someone had already ambushed him. When he tried to escape, it was already too late. The huge inertia made him unable to turn at all.
Dozens of kilograms of water squeezed the tiger head spot's body, imprisoning its figure.
Liang Qu twisted his body and swung over the net, like hitting a beautiful golf shot, and caught the tiger head spot in the net!
pretty!
Liang Qu quickly flipped the net-catching pole and wrapped the tiger head spot in the net., stepped forward and held the fish in his arms with the net, swam all the way back to the surface and threw it into the cabin.
